about: Expectations of the save eval (#30). facts: what the summary must say, judged by Claude (see judge.md). tags: topic words the saved tags should overlap. must_not: text that must not appear in the summary or tags. An unreadable page must stay link only, with no summary.

facts: Ownership is a set of rules that govern how a Rust program manages memory
Rust checks the ownership rules at compile time, so they cost nothing at run time
Each value has one owner, and the value is dropped when the owner goes out of scope
must_not: garbage collector is used by rust

facts: Recoverable errors are returned as a Result<T, E> value, an enum with Ok and Err variants
The ? operator passes an error up to the calling function
unwrap and expect return the value in Ok, and panic when the value is Err
must_not: exceptions are the main way rust handles errors

facts: Cargo has two main profiles: dev (cargo build) and release (cargo build --release)
The opt-level setting controls the number of optimisations, from 0 to 3
The defaults are opt-level 0 for dev and 3 for release, and Cargo.toml can override them
Variables are immutable by default in Rust
A variable can be made mutable with the mut keyword
Constants use const, must always have a type annotation and are always immutable
Shadowing lets a new variable reuse a name with let
Lists have methods such as append, extend, insert, remove, pop and sort
List comprehensions give a short way to make lists
Tuples are immutable sequences, and sets hold unique items
A dictionary maps keys to values
An if statement can have elif and else parts
A for statement loops over the items of any sequence
The range() function makes arithmetic sequences
The match statement compares a value against patterns
list.sort() sorts in place, while sorted() returns a new sorted list
The key parameter takes a function that is called on each element before comparing
Python sorts are guaranteed to be stable
operator.itemgetter and attrgetter make key functions
Tardigrades are microscopic animals, also called water bears or moss piglets
They are eight-legged, segmented animals
They survive extreme conditions by entering a dried state called cryptobiosis
They live in many places on Earth, from mountains to the deep sea
SQLite is a free and open-source relational database engine written in the C programming language
It is not a standalone application but a library that developers embed in their applications
SQLite's source code is in the public domain
It was created by D. Richard Hipp in 2000
must_not: it is a server database like postgresql

facts: The Moon is Earth's only natural satellite
It orbits the Earth about once every 27 days
The Moon is not man-made and is usually visible in the night sky
Das Brandenburger Tor ist ein Triumphtor in Berlin
Es wurde 1788 bis 1791 nach Plänen von Carl Gotthard Langhans gebaut
Oben steht die Quadriga mit der Siegesgöttin Victoria
Das Tor steht am Pariser Platz und wurde in der Teilung Deutschlands zum Symbol
Phở là một món ăn truyền thống của Việt Nam
Thành phần chính là bánh phở và nước dùng cùng thịt bò hoặc thịt gà
Phở có nguồn gốc ở miền Bắc Việt Nam, vùng Nam Định và Hà Nội
Có hai kiểu chính: phở Bắc và phở Nam
HTTP is a protocol for fetching resources such as HTML documents
It is a client-server protocol: requests are sent by the client, usually a web browser
HTTP is stateless, but cookies can create sessions
It is an application-layer protocol sent over TCP
Flexbox is a one-dimensional layout method that lays out items in rows or columns
display: flex turns an element into a flex container
flex-direction chooses the main axis, row or column
flex-wrap lets items wrap onto several lines
must_not: grid is the same as flexbox

facts: Array.prototype.map() creates a new array with the result of calling a function on every element
It calls a function once for each element and builds the new array from the results
The callback gets the element, its index and the array
map skips empty slots in sparse arrays
must_not: map changes the original array in place

facts: RFC 3986 defines the generic syntax of a Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
A URI has scheme, authority, path, query and fragment parts
Reserved characters and percent-encoding are defined
It obsoletes RFC 2732, 2396 and 1808
A bookmark is a thin marking tool used to keep track of a reader's progress in a book
It is commonly made of card, leather or fabric
A history section is covered
must_not: a bookmark is a web browser feature
